notes: value: the raw atlas_calendar field value (an object, or a JSON string). valid: the SDK reader (readCalendarValue) returns a calendar; false means not a calendar, the reader shows bare numbers.
words: exactly what formatStep prints. breakdown: breakdownStep with its keys, except era, which is the era's name (or null) in place of the era object.

cases.name: refuse-version
cases.why: version is not 1

cases.name: refuse-grain-missing
cases.why: grain absent: required

cases.name: refuse-grain-not-string
cases.why: grain is not a string

cases.name: refuse-months-unequal
cases.why: months names and lengths not the same length

cases.name: refuse-months-empty
cases.why: months names and lengths of zero length

cases.name: refuse-month-length-zero
cases.why: a month length is not a whole number from 1 (0)

cases.name: refuse-month-length-fraction
cases.why: a month length is not a whole number (2.5)

cases.name: refuse-year-steps-zero
cases.why: bundles.year.steps is not a whole number from 1

cases.name: refuse-week-length-zero
cases.why: bundles.week.length is not a whole number from 1

cases.name: refuse-week-names-not-list
cases.why: bundles.week.names is not a list

cases.name: refuse-every-years-zero
cases.why: an intercalary every_years is not a whole number from 1

cases.name: refuse-eras-not-list
cases.why: eras is not a list (an object)

cases.name: refuse-eras-falsy
cases.why: eras present but not a list (0; false and "" alike)

cases.name: refuse-era-name
cases.why: an era lacks a string name

cases.name: refuse-era-start
cases.why: an era lacks a numeric start (a string "0")

cases.name: refuse-intercalary-not-list
cases.why: intercalary is not a list (an object)

cases.name: refuse-intercalary-falsy
cases.why: intercalary present but not a list (""; false and 0 alike)

cases.name: refuse-intercalary-name
cases.why: an intercalary entry lacks a string name

cases.name: refuse-intercalary-after-month
cases.why: an intercalary entry lacks a whole after_month (1.5)

cases.name: refuse-json-string-broken
cases.why: a JSON-string value that does not parse

cases.name: refuse-json-string-loose
cases.why: a JSON string that is not strict JSON (single quotes)

cases.name: refuse-eras-false
cases.why: eras present but not a list (false)

cases.name: refuse-era-start-fraction
cases.why: an era start that is not a whole number (0.5)

cases.name: refuse-era-end-fraction
cases.why: an era end that is not a whole number (10.5)

cases.name: refuse-year-base-string
cases.why: a year_base that is not 0 or 1 (the string "1")

cases.name: refuse-month-name-not-string
cases.why: a month name that is not a string

cases.name: refuse-weekday-name-not-string
cases.why: a weekday name that is not a string

cases.name: json-string-valid
cases.why: the same object as a JSON string reads like the object

cases.name: months-plain-free-week
cases.why: default months template; Euclidean floor for negative steps (step -1 ends year -1); free week anchored at step 0; unknown keys ignored

cases.name: intercalary-before-month-1
cases.why: intercalary after_month 0 opens every year; default intercalary template

cases.name: intercalary-leap-every-4
cases.why: every_years 4 by floored modulo: year 0 and year -4 are leap years (21 steps), others 20

cases.name: intercalary-not-in-week
cases.why: in_week false: the day has no weekday and the free week does not advance over it

cases.name: week-nested
cases.why: nested week restarts each month; an intercalary day (in_week default) has no weekday in nested mode

cases.name: eras-restart-base-1
cases.why: restart era counts from the year its start falls in, from year_base 1 (default); abbrev is printed; a step before any era prints no era

cases.name: eras-no-restart-and-base-0
cases.why: restart false shows the year index; year_base 0 counts from 0; an era without abbrev prints its name

cases.name: era-down-pivot-0
cases.why: a down era counts toward its pivot (BC); the pivot step belongs to the up era

cases.name: era-down-mid-year-pivot
cases.why: a down era whose pivot falls mid-year: counted from the year holding the step before the pivot, which reads year_base (1); no year zero (SDK 4.42.2)

cases.name: era-overlap-latest-start
cases.why: overlapping eras: the latest start wins; no months: default template is {year} {era}

cases.name: era-overlap-down-later-start
cases.why: a down era (pivot 100, no end) overlaps an up era from 0: the later start (the down era) wins; and an up era without end ends at the next era's start even when that era counts down, so from step 100 no era holds

cases.name: era-tie-up-wins-listed-second
cases.why: equal starts: the up era wins the tie over a non-up spelling listed first

cases.name: era-tie-up-wins-listed-first
cases.why: equal starts: the up era wins the tie whatever the listing order

cases.name: era-tie-direction-null
cases.why: equal starts: a null direction is absent, so up; any direction but "down" counts up, and of two up eras the later in the list wins

cases.name: era-tie-two-up
cases.why: two up eras on one start: the later in the list wins

cases.name: no-months-year-steps
cases.why: a calendar without months (bundles.year.steps 12); free week with no months; default template without months

cases.name: no-year-structure
cases.why: no months and no year: every step is one year

cases.name: absent-likes
cases.why: eras null, intercalary null, week null and months false read as absent, not as "not a list"

cases.name: format-unknown-token
cases.why: an unknown token prints as written; {step} prints the raw step; a custom format_intercalary

cases.name: format-empty-known-token
cases.why: known tokens with no value (no week, no era) print empty and the comma separators around them close up

cases.name: format-empty-known-dash
cases.why: only , ; and the middle dot (and spaces) close up around an empty token; a dash stays

cases.name: week-names-short
cases.why: week names fewer than its length: the SDK reads the calendar but gives no weekday

cases.name: months-and-year-steps
cases.why: months and bundles.year both present: the SDK reads it and the months set the year length

cases.name: intercalary-after-month-out-of-range
cases.why: after_month beyond the month count: the SDK reads it, the day counts in the year length but is placed nowhere, so its step has no month, day or intercalary name
